INSERT INTO public.canonical_orders (
  schema_version, source, external_ref, location_key, order_type, status,
  customer, items, payment, vat_lines, raw_payload_id
) VALUES (
  '1.1', 'takeaway'::public.order_source, $1, $2, $3::public.order_channel_type,
  'received'::public.order_state,
  $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8::bigint
)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_ref) DO UPDATE SET
  items = EXCLUDED.items,
  payment = EXCLUDED.payment,
  vat_lines = EXCLUDED.vat_lines,
  customer = EXCLUDED.customer,
  order_type = EXCLUDED.order_type,
  updated_at = now()
WHERE canonical_orders.location_key = EXCLUDED.location_key
RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS was_inserted, status;

WITH transition AS (
  UPDATE public.canonical_orders SET status = 'normalized'::public.order_state
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'received'::public.order_state RETURNING id
),
enqueues AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN public.pgmq_send_order('q_orders_push_ls', jsonb_build_object('canonical_id',$1::text,'source','takeaway','external_ref',$2::text,'location_key',$3::text)) END AS ls_msg_id,
    CASE WHEN $4::boolean AND $5::text = 'delivery' THEN public.pgmq_send_order('q_orders_push_shipday', jsonb_build_object('canonical_id',$1::text,'source','takeaway','external_ref',$2::text,'location_key',$3::text)) END AS shipday_msg_id
),
plu_map_lookup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name,
    (SELECT l.sku FROM public.raw_ls_products l WHERE l.location_key=$3::text AND LOWER(l.name)=LOWER(name) AND l.visible=true AND l.sku IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS candidate_sku,
    (SELECT l.name FROM public.raw_ls_products l WHERE l.location_key=$3::text AND LOWER(l.name)=LOWER(name) AND l.visible=true AND l.sku IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS candidate_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.raw_ls_products l WHERE l.location_key=$3::text AND LOWER(l.name)=LOWER(name) AND l.visible=true AND l.sku IS NOT NULL) AS match_count
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb) AS name
),
plu_map AS (
  INSERT INTO public.takeaway_plu_map (location_key, takeaway_name, ls_plu, ls_product_name, auto_matched, last_seen_at, order_count)
  SELECT $3::text, pml.name,
    CASE WHEN pml.match_count=1 THEN pml.candidate_sku ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN pml.match_count=1 THEN pml.candidate_name ELSE NULL END,
    pml.match_count=1, NOW(), 1
  FROM plu_map_lookup pml
  ON CONFLICT (location_key, takeaway_name) DO UPDATE SET
    last_seen_at=NOW(),
    order_count=public.takeaway_plu_map.order_count+1,
    ls_plu=COALESCE(public.takeaway_plu_map.ls_plu, EXCLUDED.ls_plu),
    ls_product_name=COALESCE(public.takeaway_plu_map.ls_product_name, EXCLUDED.ls_product_name),
    auto_matched=public.takeaway_plu_map.auto_matched OR EXCLUDED.auto_matched
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM transition) AS transitioned_id,
  (SELECT ls_msg_id FROM enqueues) AS ls_msg_id,
  (SELECT shipday_msg_id FROM enqueues) AS shipday_msg_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM plu_map) AS plu_upserts;
